text:
Jess - Sales: FYI ACME POC: during their load run we're seeing intermittent 5xxs (~502/503) ~5-8% of requests. Demo tomorrow, customer blocked. Can infra help?
Sam J: can you paste a sample request-id and time window? Also which model/route they hit?
Jess - Sales: request-id: r-0a1b2c3d4e, window ~17:22-17:26 UTC. Hitting /v1/generate with model=rwd-large, concurrency from their side ~120rps.
Anya R: thx. quick checks: do headers show any rate-limit or remaining tokens? e.g., `x-redwood-remaining` or `x-rw-queue`?
Jess - Sales: they attached curl output, headers look normal, no 429. Errors are 502/503 from our side.
InfraBot: deploy/rollout detected: new runtime build `release-2026-03-18` rolling 16:59 UTC — no failures reported at deploy time.
Mike (ops): paging in. Looking at logs now, sending a tail snippet. Can you re-run a failing request with `-H \"X-Request-ID: r-0a1b2c3d4e\"` so I can grep?
Jess - Sales: re-ran and pasted below.
Jess - Sales: ```
[2026-03-20T17:23:12Z] r-0a1b2c3d4e model=rwd-large worker=gpupool-7 error=502 upstream_err=\"kv-cache OOM\"
[2026-03-20T17:23:12Z] r-0a1b2c3d4e throttled=true reason=capacity_throttle queue_len=1024
[2026-03-20T17:23:12Z] autoscale.state=pending wait=18s target=gpupool-8
```
Sam J: ok that log is useful — looks like the prefix/KV cache pressure + backlog caused an internal 502 when worker dropped the request. The autoscaler was still spinning up (pending).
Anya R: do we have fallback routing enabled for this org? if so it should route to burstpool or reduced model variant. If not, we need to enable canary fallback for POC.
Mike (ops): confirmed fallback not hitting for this customer due to a routing rule mismatch (org tag mismatch -> didn't match burstpool rule). I'm toggling a temporary policy to allow region-burst fallback.
Mike (ops): applied temporary policy -> route fallback to `gpupool-burst` and allow `rwd-medium` as a compatible variant. :sparkles:
Jess - Sales: customer re-ran the same test 2m later -> error rate dropped to ~0.4%. They reported demo green. :tada:
Sam J: root cause summary for handoff: high-concurrency spike + KV cache OOM on large model + autoscaler lag (18s) + routing rule mismatch prevented burstpool fallback.
Anya R: mitigation checklist: 1) short-term: enable fallback routing (done), 2) increase burstpool headroom for POC org, 3) post-mortem: tune autoscale thresholds and KV cache eviction for rwd-large.
Jess - Sales: customer asks about cost if we reserve burstpool for their demo (they want guaranteed headroom). Any quick pricing pointer?
Mike (ops): for short POC bursts we can offer a temporary reserved burst at an hourly bump; I'll DM pricing to you and loop sales engineering. For long term they'd need a Dedicated commit.
Jess - Sales: thanks — please also send the minimal log excerpt I can include in the POC report (they asked why 5xx happened).
Mike (ops): sending copy for the report: ```
2026-03-20T17:23:12Z r-0a1b2c3d4e error=502 \"kv-cache OOM\"; throttled=true; autoscale_pending=18s; fallback_not_triggered (routing mismatch)
```
Sam J: follow-up action items: @Mike (ops) confirm autoscale tuning plan by EOD; @Anya R verify KV eviction thresholds; @Jess - Sales confirm whether customer wants short reserved burst for next week.
Jess - Sales: will ask customer and update here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
